# 🚀 Deployment / Handoff Checklist

## Artifact control
- [ ] PBIX and workbook versions are paired.
- [ ] Source paths and refresh behavior are verified.
- [ ] Critical KPIs reconcile.
- [ ] Visual and interaction checks are complete.
- [ ] Sensitive data and credentials are reviewed.
- [ ] Genuine screenshots and documentation are updated.

## Optional Power BI Service release
- [ ] Target workspace and owner approved.
- [ ] Data classification and audience reviewed.
- [ ] Credentials configured securely.
- [ ] Gateway requirement assessed.
- [ ] Refresh configuration tested.
- [ ] Workspace/report permissions tested as a viewer.
- [ ] RLS tested if implemented.
- [ ] Rollback owner and procedure confirmed.

## Sign-off
Record release commit, file hashes, reviewer, date, destination, evidence, and unresolved risks.
